raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-15 v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and the pipeline treats both as local. v2 rows are therefore shifted about 6 hours late, which pushes some evening local transactions into 00:00-06:00 and onto the wrong txn_date. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago in silver_transactions, and deriving txn_date from the corrected value, should fix the time distribution and the 2026-01-19 volume drop.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
